caption: The drawing depicts a large, cylindrical jug with a narrow neck, slightly flared rim, and no visible handle from the front view. The jug is colored in a grayish-brown tone, giving it a stoneware appearance, and it sits centered within a lightly outlined square border. On the upper front section of the jug, there is blue text reading “REDINGER & CAIRE POUGHKEEPSIE NY” with the number “2” above it. Below the text, a decorative blue floral or abstract swirl pattern is illustrated. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset sketch showing a side view of the jug’s handle, rendered in the same color as the main jug, providing additional detail about the jug’s design. The background is an off-white, lightly textured paper.
title: Jug
